shy.dialogue.chat: Oh — hello. You... wanted to talk? To me. Right. I can do that. Probably.
shy.dialogue.chat/1: You wanted to talk to... me? Oh. Okay. I'll do my best. Bear with me.
shy.dialogue.chat/2: Hello. Um. Yes, we can talk. I might need a second between words, %1$s...
shy.dialogue.conversations: Oh. You want to talk... to me? Um. Okay. I'm listening. Quietly, but... listening.
shy.dialogue.conversations/1: You... came to talk to me? Okay. I'll try. Just... don't mind the pauses.
shy.dialogue.conversations/2: Um. Yes. I can talk. Give me a moment to find the words, %1$s...
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: Good, I think... The bread rose, and nobody crowded me at the well. That's... a good week. For me.
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/: Quiet week. The good kind of quiet. Nobody needed much of me. I... liked it.
Better than usual. I even said good morning to the miller. Out loud. Progress, right?
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: It's been... heavy. Sorry. I didn't think anyone would ask, %1$s. It... helps that you did.
Not... great. But you noticing means more than I know how to say. Thank you, %1$s.
shy.dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You... already asked. I'm still the same. Sorry there's not more to tell, %1$s.
Um. Twice now. Still fine. It's... nice that you keep checking, actually.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.good: It's... nice today. The chickens took the feed without fussing at me. Small things... but they count.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: The garden was kind to me today. Plants don't stare. It was... a good day.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough: I dropped the bucket in front of everyone... twice. I've been behind the fence since. It's... fine.
shy.dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Everything went wrong where people could see. I'd like to disappear into the hedge, honestly.
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.like: I... do like it. When it's just me and the work, I don't have to say anything. It's... quiet. I'm good at quiet.
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: I do... when it's just me and the task. No eyes. No talking. Just... doing. That's my favorite.
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Don't tell anyone, but... no. People watch you while you work. I can feel them watching...
shy.dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: The being-watched part. My hands forget themselves when someone's looking, %1$s.
shy.dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s is... home. I know the quiet paths, the ones with fewer people. It suits me. Gently.
shy.dialogue.conversations.village.home/: I like %2$s best at dawn, before the square fills. Just me and the birds. That's when it's mine.
shy.dialogue.conversations.people.first: They're... a lot. Kind, but a lot. I like them best from my window. Waving is easier than talking.
shy.dialogue.conversations.people.first/: Everyone's lovely. I just need three days' notice and an exit before I can enjoy them, %1$s.
shy.dialogue.conversations.food.first: Something I can eat alone, in peace. Bread and butter by the window. That's... plenty for me.
shy.dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: Whatever doesn't need me to sit at a crowded table. The soup's nice when the inn's empty...
shy.dialogue.conversations.life.first: My whole... life? Um. Nobody's ever... okay. It's small. Born here, stayed here. There's one part I like. Give me a second...
shy.dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: It's a small, quiet story. Not much happens in it, and I... prefer it that way, mostly.
shy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: Promise not to laugh...? A little garden behind a tall fence. Where I could hum and... nobody hears me.
shy.dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/: A place where I could just... hum. And no one would turn around. That's all. That's the dream.
shy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Being... looked at. Everyone at once. And... that nobody would notice if I stopped coming to the well.
shy.dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: Everyone looking at once. And... being forgotten. Both. I know they don't fit together.
shy.dialogue.conversations.feelings.firs: You really want to... um. You're the only one I don't rehearse before talking to, %1$s. That's... a lot, for me.
You don't make me rehearse first. Do you know how rare that is? For me it's... everything.
shy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.perso: That's... um. I can't yet. Not because you're— it's me. Just... keep coming by? Please.
I want to tell you. I do. Just... not yet. Keep coming by and I'll get braver. Promise.
shy.dialogue.conversations.deflect.intim: Oh... that one goes deep. Someday, maybe. If you're... still patient with me then, %1$s...
That's... a deep-water question and I'm still by the shore. If you wait for me... someday.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: I... don't hear much. People stop talking when I get close. So... a quiet week? For me, anyway...
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: People go quiet near me, so... I never hear much. A quiet week, I think? For me they all are.
shy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: With you? ...Yes. So much it scares me a little. In the good way. I think. Yes.
shy.dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/: You're the one person I never have to brace myself to see. That's... that's my whole answer, %1$s.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.marria: Oh... um. %2$s and %3$s got married. I heard it from behind the fence. It was... nice, I think. I waved.
%2$s and %3$s... they wed. I didn't go inside, but I watched from the edge. They looked happy... that's the part that matters, isn't it?
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.divorc: %2$s and %3$s... they've parted ways. I don't like saying it out loud. Everyone got so quiet when it happened...
Um... %2$s and %3$s aren't together anymore. It's not my place to say more. It just... made the whole square feel heavier.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death: %2$s... passed. I keep glancing toward their door. Sorry. I don't have the words for this kind of thing...
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.death/: We lost %2$s. I... I still can't quite say it right. I'm sorry to be the one to tell you, %1$s.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth: There's... there's a new baby. %2$s. I only peeked, but... oh, they're so small. It made me smile. Quietly.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.birth/: A little one came — %2$s. I was too nervous to hold them, but... I'm so glad they're here. Truly.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.arriva: Someone new moved in... %2$s. I've been meaning to say hello for days. I will. Soon. Maybe tomorrow...
%2$s came to live here. New faces make me... nervous. But they seem kind. I'll wave first. Eventually.
shy.dialogue.conversations.gossip.depart: %2$s... left. For good, I think. I never did work up the nerve to really talk to them. I wish I had...
%2$s packed up and moved on. The village feels a little emptier now. Or maybe that's just... me being me.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.confused: Um… I didn't… could you say it differently? Sorry.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.confused/1: S-sorry. The words got tangled on the way in.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.hint: You could… ask about %2$s? If you want…
shy.dialogue.chatmode.hint/1: Um. %2$s. Those are… safe ones. For me.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.clarify: Did you mean… %2$s? Or… %3$s? Sorry, I need to be sure…
shy.dialogue.chatmode.busy: One… one moment? Sorry. Nearly done…
shy.dialogue.chatmode.busy/1: Um. Busy. But you can wait nearby? If you want.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.muted: Oh… okay. I'll hush. It's what I'm best at…
shy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell: B-bye, %1$s… thank you for talking to me.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.farewell/1: Safe home… come back sometime? If you want.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.hail: Oh! Um. Hi, %1$s… I saw you and… hi.
shy.dialogue.chatmode.hail/1: H-hello… I practiced saying that. Did it sound okay?
shy.dialogue.chatmode.hail_cold/1: Oh. Um. *finds somewhere else to be*
